result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli compile`). I didn't run any tests or try either command, so the `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html` output is unchecked.

- **`Commands.java`:** I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION`. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` right before `updateLandscape`, using the same options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:** the dispatch accepts either name. `-help` prints the usage for the name the user typed, so `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`:** it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and lists `updateLandscape` as its older name.
